focus: Uncited doctor scripts: exit codes that hide failures, writes in check-only routes, flag/asset mismatches across the ten never-cited engines

graphEvents.label: Does every doctor script's --json stdout parse as one JSON document?
Two --json stream contracts in the doctor engine family
MCP Doctor says Node 24, gates on 20.11.0
MCP Doctor exits 1 on this repo for one optional provider token
Orphan check returns 0 when it could not scan
Orphan line tells the operator to list with the reaping flag
Setup collapses a nine-leg battery into one row and discards the failing leg

label: The doctor engine family ships two incompatible --json contracts on the same stream: sk-code-quality-config.cjs status --json and git-standards.cjs status --json exit 0 while appending a STATUS= human line after the JSON document (whole-stdout JSON.parse fails at byte 8459 and 1920 respectively), whereas mcp-doctor.sh emits one JSON object and nothing else and README.markdown:94 advertises that purity as the norm for sk-skill-check.cjs; _routes.yaml hands the agent only --json, so nothing at dispatch time reveals which shape to expect.

MCP Doctor's not-found branch tells the operator Code Mode requires Node 24 (mcp-doctor.sh:109) while the same script's gate accepts >=20.11.0 (mcp-doctor.sh:101,105), so an operator on Node 20.11 through 23.x passes a check whose sibling message calls that version unsupported; measured on this host the node row reads PASS v26.8.2.

On this repository mcp-doctor.sh --json exits 1 with pass 18 / warn 1 / fail 0, the single warning being an optional provider credential (webflow_WEBFLOW_TOKEN=missing), so the healthy-vs-warning boundary is 'every configured provider has a token' rather than 'MCP works'; no /doctor:setup leg runs MCP Doctor today, and nothing documents that this must stay true, even though every setup leg reads 'Exit 0 passes. Any other exit fails'.

README.markdown:126 promises orphan-process-check.cjs exits 1 on an unexpected error, but both scan-failure branches return 0 (uid unavailable at :559-560, a throwing ps at :567-568), so a doctor leg that could not scan reports success and the only signal is the sentence it prints; /doctor:setup treats the leg as informational, which caps severity but not the wrong exit-code table.

The orphan summary line (orphan-process-check.cjs:332) and the setup presentation template (doctor-setup-presentation.txt:75) tell the operator to 'list them with ... --reap', i.e. to read the listing by typing the flag whose confirmed form sends SIGTERM; the dry form is safe and prints a confirmation command at :588, and the guard sits only one line below the instruction at presentation:80.

/doctor:setup maps the whole sk-code battery to one PASS/FAIL row (doctor-setup.yaml:53), but the battery runs nine legs and prints nine verdicts (measured: STATUS=OK legs=9) and its failure form is a single STATUS=FAIL failed=<n> skipped=<n> line, so an operator whose setup fails sees 'sk-code failed' and must rerun a nine-leg battery, including node --test, to learn which leg and which repair line failed.

The /doctor:setup manifest declares four script_invocations (_routes.yaml:360-363) while the workflow asset runs six commands, the two unlisted ones being the session-relaunch history hop (doctor-setup.yaml:58) and orphan-process-check.cjs --summary (doctor-setup.yaml:59); setup.md:69 treats the orphan line as part of the operator-visible output, so the omission is in the machine manifest alone and a manifest-only audit of what /doctor:setup executes is incomplete.

doctor-phrase-reach.cjs:18 claims 'It is strictly REPORT-ONLY. It writes nothing in the repository' and :21 concedes 'The freshness check may also refresh its cached build record inside the ignored dist folder', which _routes.yaml:215 repeats; the temp database write is genuinely outside the tree (mkdtemp under os.tmpdir, removed at :196), so the only in-repo touch is a gitignored dist record that the route's gate3_location never declares.
verify: grep -n 'ignored dist folder' .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/doctor-phrase-reach.cjs; grep -n 'router-reach' -A6 .skilled/commands/doctor/_routes.yaml | grep gate3_location

label: doctor-helper-match.cjs accepts and validates --top=<1-5> (:526, :561), but the route manifest (:456), the workflow asset and helper.md name only --json, --table, --areas, --area and --intent, so the matcher's candidate-count knob is undiscoverable from /doctor:helper even though the code path is live.

Six doctor engines were executed in their check form this iteration with the documented exits: mcp-doctor --json (1, one credential warn), mcp-doctor --json --root /nonexistent (3, zero stdout bytes, claim verified), sk-code-quality-config check/status (0), git-standards status --json (0), sk-code-setup-check (0, legs=9), skill-graph-freshness (0, every drift row none). doctor-phrase-reach was not run because its own header owns an in-repo dist write.

direction: Flag/asset mismatch across the ten focus scripts: an asset passing a flag the script rejects
reason: Each documented invocation was matched to its parser and held: --json/--table/--areas/--area/--intent/--top for doctor-helper-match, --json/--apply/--repo for git-standards, --summary/--reap/--yes/--min-age-min for orphan-process-check, --root for mcp-doctor (bad root measured as exit 3 with no report), --apply gating for sk-skill-convert and --plan-digest for agents-md-embed. No rejected-flag defect found in this set.
